source_evidence: Investor.gov has a free and simple search tool that allows you to find out if your investment professional is licensed and registered, and if the firm or person (registered representative) has had run-ins with regulators or received complaints from investors.
answer: Before choosing a broker, check whether the broker is licensed and registered and whether the person or firm has a legal or disciplinary history. The source says brokers generally must register with the SEC and become FINRA members. It also describes a free search tool for checking registration, regulatory run-ins, and investor complaints. Check both the individual broker and the firm; your state securities regulator may offer additional information.
